text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to win this! To repay my 
debt—no matter what!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "No, I am! I am the one...!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There's no way—I could ever yield!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!!

Narita Top Road and the other two burned 
through all their passion. But...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
None of the Big Three claim victory! This 
is an utterly unexpected result.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Did they wait too long for the other to 
make a move? No, rather—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Just the opposite. I seem to 
have gotten too worked up trying to pull 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. And we weren't the only ones 
who wanted to win...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone gave it everything they had. I 
don't think there was a single girl 
without a chance to win."

Victory had slipped through my fingers. 
Yet even that bittersweet memory was 
something unique to this special race.

And so, with both the Satsuki Sho and the 
Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby) over, the 
two great spring battles came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, Opera O-chan, great work out 
there!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um, there's something I really need to 
tell you both.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What is it, Top Road-san? So formal all of 
a sudden...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: This spring—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the match!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There were so many happy moments, and so 
many frustrating ones too! But—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to having the two of you with me, I 
was able to run a truly wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It was fun, very much so.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It was... fun...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's too early to thank me. 
Because...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What is it that we are aiming for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: What we... are aiming for?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, what we strive for is to become the 
fastest Umamusume, or the luckiest 
Umamusume... Surely it doesn't just end 
there, does it?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's right, the "strongest" Umamusume! 
More than anything, isn't that the title 
you want?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And the race where the strongest Umamusume 
is said to claim victory is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The autumn 'Kikuka Sho'! The race that 
concludes the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho... Indeed. The finish line 
of the Classic road. A long-distance 
3,000m race...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, unless we traverse that thorny 
path, our first act won't be over."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let's meet again in the fall—my friend!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, Opera O-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It was... fun...? Racing is... fun...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing. Nothing at all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There were things I did well and things I 
didn't, so a lot happened, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: But... in my own way...

I gently caught her collapsing body. She 
had burned completely bright and exhausted 
every ounce of her strength.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much... Thank you...

Even with her strength spent, who are 
those words overflowing from her meant 
for? But...

"I decided to let her rest for a little 
while. A brief respite. And beyond that—"

The autumn 'Kikuka Sho' awaits. The grand 
finale of the Classic Triple Crown.
